image_description: A medium-to-large tan dog standing in profile on a grassy lawn, facing right. The dog has floppy ears, a long muzzle, and a visible ridge of hair along its spine. There is a blue object (possibly a chair or bin) and human legs in the background. A watermark text overlay is present at the bottom.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is fairly long and flat with moderate stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head profile clearly shows a long, flat skull and a distinct but moderate stop between the forehead and muzzle, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is dark brown/black, which matches the wheaten coat coloration requirements (dark eyes preferred). It appears alert.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the ears are medium-sized, they are hanging down loosely rather than being 'carried close to the head' in the folded manner typical of the breed standard. They appear somewhat low-set and pendulous.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ridge of reversed hair growing forward along spine from shoulders to hips forming two symmetrical crowns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct line of reversed hair is visible along the topline. While the resolution limits seeing the fine detail of the 'crowns', the ridge structure is clearly present and follows the correct anatomical path.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat texture appears short and smooth. The color is a consistent light wheaten/tan, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest of large hound proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog exhibits a deep chest and muscular hindquarters, consistent with an athletic hound build.
The front and rear legs appear straight with good bone structure and muscle definition. No bowing or structural collapse observed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, thick at the root, and tapers naturally towards the tip. It is held in a gentle upward curve.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject is standing still in a static pose; gait dynamics cannot be evaluated from a single static image.
